correctness.rationale: Bal Lemma 2 identifies frustration with min_orientation sum_v outdeg(v)*indeg(v). Each vertex-disjoint odd cycle must contain a mixed vertex, whose contribution is at least min_{v on C}deg(v)-1. Orient each cycle alternately with exactly one min-degree mixed vertex on odd cycles, then propagate consistent pure orientations along the bridge block tree; even cycles introduce no obstruction. Equality forces exactly these chosen mixed vertices, and independent binary phase choices for their external edges yield product_C sum_{min vertices}(1+1_{d>2}) labeled signatures after dividing the globally reversed orientations by 2. Recomputed all orientations for triangle, triangle+leaf, two triangles joined by a bridge, and two triangles joined by a length-2 path; both minima and optimal-signature counts agree.
